description: This file defines middleware functions for security-related aspects in a Node.js/Express application, including CORS configuration, security headers via Helmet, and rate limiting. It includes functions to generate CORS middleware based on environment variables, a Helmet middleware with relaxed policies, and a rate limiter setup.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a CORS middleware function configured based on environment variables, supporting both open and strict whitelists.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns a Helmet middleware with relaxed Content Security Policy and cross-origin resource policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Creates and returns a rate limiting middleware with configurable window and max requests based on environment variables.
